description: Violates §5 (verification-contract.md §5; E1–E5): the declaration omits the evidence requirements section entirely. Evidence requirements are part of the contract — evidence is embedded and re-checkable, a claim is not evidence, outcomes merge into the verification report and are recorded as lifecycle evidence. A declaration that does not affirm the evidence floor is non-conforming; the root required declaration rejects the missing 'evidence' section.
